sections.heading: Coordinate contract
sections.text: Trace points are sample-frame coordinates, NOT attachment pixels. Each control point gives the same station in three frames. Use the three non-collinear stations to interpolate an affine map from sample to image for the overlay, and a separate affine map from sample to surface for measurement. Row order and station letters have no computational meaning.

sections.heading: Measurement & editing
sections.text: Image coordinates use attachment pixels: x right, y down. Surface coordinates are millimetres on the inspected plane. Length is Euclidean endpoint distance in the surface frame, shown to 0.1 mm. Drawing scale is not a physical scale. New endpoint taps must be converted from attachment image to sample coordinates; do not change the imported original or the provider report.

sections.heading: Integration payload
sections.text: The payload below is the machine-readable companion to this sheet. calibration.controlPoints defines both maps; traces[].points uses the sample frame. Annotations retain that frame when edited.
